## What We Build & Sell (7 Core Capabilities)
1. **AI Automations & Autonomous Voice Agents**: Using AI for daily operations and autonomous lead closing. Inbound & outbound Voice Agents, chatbots, and workflow automations so no enquiry is missed — driving an immediate 30–40% jump in sales.
2. **Custom Web Applications**: Digital storefronts and community portals engineered so businesses own their audience instead of paying someone else to own customer relationships.
3. **WhatsApp / Message Booking Automations**: Engineered for SMEs requiring consistent appointments or booking-only exclusivity. Sub-60s instant replies, slot confirmations, and calendar sync.
4. **Local SEO, AEO & "GEO" (Generative Engine Optimization)**: Google Maps Top 3 rank and search optimization to be recommended by AI tools like ChatGPT, Gemini, and Perplexity when high-intent local buyers search.
5. **Customer Database & Re-engagement**: 100% private CRM data ownership with automated reminders, broadcasts, and custom remarketing to increase retainers and foster loyalty.
6. **Performance Marketing**: Customer acquisition at pace with higher retention rates and reduced CAC, executed in partnership with The Axiom Grid.
7. **Strategic Business Consultation**: Specializing across 30+ industries to guide the right way of doing business for real sales and scalable growth. Plug-and-play consultation with zero guesswork.
